narrative: After funds transfer pricing, expected loss and a capital charge, bridging returns 24% on allocated capital, wholesale finance 21% and specialist mortgages 19%. Development finance now returns about 9% — below the 13% cost of equity — because of its 150% risk weight and the Q3 stage 2 migration; the run-off books also earn about 9%.

signals.title: Capital headroom supports ~£430M more bridging
signals.excerpt: CET1 12.5% (Sep) vs 9.57% requirement + 1.5% management buffer = £48M surplus; bridging RAROC 24%.

signals.title: Development finance stage 2 up from 9.8% to 16.4%
signals.excerpt: Four South East & East schemes (£52M) moved to stage 2 in Q3; FY2026 cost of risk forecast 30 bps vs 15 bps plan.
